transition_guard_rules.draft_to_evolving: allowed, adjacent, no warning, reason optional
transition_guard_rules.draft_to_deprecated: allowed, classified skip-forward (warning only, not blocking), reason optional
transition_guard_rules.draft_to_stable: allowed with skip-forward warning but unreachable under policy (has_verification false)
transition_guard_rules.reason_required_only_for: frozen (USAGE error if empty); reason max 500 chars, no control chars, appended to Change Notes
transition_guard_rules.hard_block: status=verified -> draft is MUTATION_DENIED (n/a: all planned)
transition_guard_rules.redundant_warning: from == to (medium/low keep draft: skip the call)

transition_guard_warnings: draft->deprecated yields skip-forward warning (non-blocking); user confirmation required by policy
